$comment: The measured adoption baseline (FR-035). Every entry names a rule and a path that
was already violating when that rule landed, and downgrades it to `note`.
THIS FILE MUST DRAIN. An entry that stops matching anything is reported as
`suppression/stale` at `warn`, so a baseline cannot quietly become the status quo.
Delete an entry as soon as its defect is fixed; the gate will tell you when.
Entries are keyed on `rule` + `path` only. A line number would churn on every
unrelated edit above the defect, and a content hash would make this file unreadable
to the reviewer who has to approve each addition. One entry therefore covers every
occurrence of one rule in one file.
`reason` is required and non-empty: an entry nobody had to justify is how a
Run `pnpm prompt-lint --no-baseline` to see the true state of the surface.
Populated by T058 from a measured run; not guessed.
